note:
REGISTER. System menus and notices use the polite 합니다/하세요 (warning, new-game confirmation, credits, extra night locked/unlocked, 'press any key'); key prompts use verbal nouns ('C 또는 방수포 클릭: 숨기'); everything inside the game world (deaths, captions, the Journal, the Catalogue, dive captions) uses plain written 해라체 and addresses the player as 너; the radio and the urgent hints use curt 반말 ('움직이지 마', '하나 던져 줘'). The radio refers to the Mother as 그분 where the Italian says 'lei' (reverent and eerie); in the 1997 clipping the boy's mother is '아이 어머니', so she is not confused with 어머니 = the Mother. The HUD template '${night} ${n}' gives '밤 1' (the radio says 첫째 밤, 둘째 밤…). 'Buona pesca' = '많이 잡아.' (what you say to someone going fishing). Hatch's count ends with the traditional Korean hide-and-seek chant '꼭꼭 숨어라, 머리카락 보일라!' (also in his death line and on the counting sheet in his den); it is 13 syllables against 10 in Italian/English, so that last line of the child voice lasts about 0.5 s longer (voice.ts does not cut it; every radio line fits its time slot, checked with syllables() from voice.ts). Proper names stay in Latin letters, including Gazzetta del Golfo and Lido Sirena; written-out dates follow Korean order (1997년 8월 17일), 14·08·1997 stays.

FISH (real names). I could not consult FishBase, Wikipedia or Wikidata (blocked by the network policy), so the Korean species names come from memory: a native speaker or a Korean fish list should check them, especially 귀족도미 (Sparus aurata), 은밀복 (Lagocephalus sceleratus), 꼬리기름상어 (Hexanchus griseus), 대주둥치 (Macroramphosus scolopax), 옥두놀래기류 (Xyrichtys), 색가오리류 (Dasyatis), 황돔류 (Dentex). Many Mediterranean species have no Korean name: as the brief asks, I used the Korean group name instead of inventing one (도미류 = a sea bream, for ten sparids; also 놀래기류, 민어류, 홍어류, 쏨뱅이류, 갈치류, 두툽상어류, 노랑촉수류…), or the loanword Korean actually uses (스프랫, 터봇, 도버솔, 유럽메를루사, 블루피시, 위버피시, 바이퍼피시, 폼파노). The scientific name printed next to it identifies the species.

FISH (pun names). 2-5 syllables, except 트래킹만새기 (6: VHS 'tracking' + 만새기). Some puns rest on the Korean name: 귀족도미 → 귀신도미 (noble → ghost), 청대치 → 뼈대치 (뼈대 = skeleton), 정어리 + 썩소 (sardonic smirk, from 썩은 미소), 블루피시 → 블러드피시, 청새리상어 → 피새리상어, 괴수염대구 (괴수 'beast' + 수염 'beard', like Forkbeast). Where the Italian joke could not survive, the description was adapted the way the English one was (퀭한돔 'hollow-eyed': the hollow look; 죽은척상어: plays dead).

IMAGES. Crayons: the drafts were good; I changed only 'AH AH AH' to 히히히 (Lampy's mischievous giggle; 하하하 is a hearty laugh). IL MIO TESORO (Robin's drawing) has no gender in Korean. Flyer: the draft texts are natural and kept; I only rebalanced the speech bubble like the Italian (short / long / short: 우리 / 아이들이 배가 / 고파요!), with exactly the same characters, so the font subsets in tools/render/fonts/annuncio/cjk/ still cover everything. Optional, more idiomatic: nastro '야간 근무 ★ 선상 낚시' (선상 낚시 = boat fishing) and '경력 무관!'; they need new glyphs (선, 상, 력), i.e. 'annuncio.py --sottoinsiemi' with the full fonts. The ★ stays because Do Hyeon has no '·'.

FOR THE DEVELOPERS (not changed, not my files). 1) src/engine/voice.ts: a word that contains Hangul is read character by character and Latin letters inside it are skipped, so 'Gulpy는', 'Robin은', 'Soggy가' voice only the particle; the timing is fine, but the names are not spoken. 2) LORE_TEXT den_lampy says 'KG 3,1 – luglio 2003' (translated as 3.1KG – 2003년 7월), while docs/LOCALIZZAZIONE.md says the cradle card in the den image now reads '3100 g – 7 / 2003': the Italian/English source may need updating.
